scope: Design proposals only. A: small 3D-style preview; B/C: detailed profile illustrations. No runtime modifications or paid Meshy generation.

variants.name: Loadout-Workbench
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity 16:9 PC game menu design proposal, not an engine screenshot.
Project: Forbidden Code: Survivor, a neon cyberpunk deckbuilding bullet-heaven.
Input image 1 is a STYLE/FEATURE reference for the existing game's cyan/magenta glass UI, rain-soaked city background and Signal Dock music player. Do NOT repeat its giant black character stage or huge model. Input image 2 is an IDENTITY reference for ZERO: graphite hooded precision assassin, black geometric full-face mask, cobalt optical lens and small blue light strips, sleek hoverboard. Preserve his design; show a high-quality smoothly shaded 3D-style full-body render with believable dark fabric, brushed metal and restrained blue neon. No combat pose, casting, particles, outstretched arms or weapon fire. Hands resting naturally, quiet breathing stance. Character is a small supporting thumbnail, maximum 180-210 pixels tall in a 1920x1080 composition, NOT the focal point.
Combine rider and deck selection on ONE screen. Rider controls always LEFT, deck selection and editing always RIGHT. The right side must dominate visually and occupy about 75% of useful width. Give five small selectable rider portraits labeled NEON, VEX, ROOK, ZERO, MIRA; ZERO selected. His role: PRECISION ASSASSIN. Two short perk lines: TARGET LOCK / +25% marked damage; PERFECT LINE / every third cast pierces. Tradeoff: -20% area radius. Full body and hoverboard remain visible despite SMALL size. Optional subtle drag-to-rotate glyph; NO auto-spin, animation tabs or attack-preview buttons. Only one calm idle is intended.
Deck rules must be coherent: 8 draft programs and 2 starters chosen from those eight. Show exactly 8 distinct chosen programs, with exactly 2 marked STARTER: Pulse Dart and Kinetic Cards. Other six: Arc Relay, Ghost Link, Neon Cataclysm, Photon Lance, Halo Nova, Talisman Guard. Show energy-style individual card illustrations and varied cyan, pink, violet, amber accents; no blood, skeletons or literal fireballs. Arc Relay art can show branching energy chains. Clear school filters ALL / PULSE / PRISM / KINETIC / BARRIER. Saved preset control PRESET 1 / PRESET 2 / PRESET 3, SAVE DECK and one strong chamfered ENTER ARENA button on bottom right.
Across top a compact title FORBIDDEN CODE: SURVIVOR and secondary nav HOW TO / SETTINGS / LEADERBOARD / CLOSE. Bottom includes a narrow, elegant Signal Dock mini music player with tiny album cover, reactive spectrum, graphical previous/play/next controls, volume icon and TRACKS. Keep all UI comfortably inside safe margins and avoid overlap. Fine glow borders, dark translucent readable panels, restrained honeycomb texture, sharp legible typography, generous alignment and breathing room. City visible behind panels but muted enough that every label is legible. Distinct visual hierarchy: deck content first, primary action second, character third. No gray prototype blocks, no huge black rectangle, no excessive bloom, no extra characters as background heroes, no desktop/window chrome, no annotations outside the actual menu.
This is a polished DESIGN MOCKUP: depict the desired higher-quality render, not a promise the current Meshy mesh already has these details.

OPTION A — LOADOUT WORKBENCH. Design a calm modular two-column layout. Narrow LEFT identity panel, about one quarter of the screen: small character render 190px tall with name above, compact five-portrait picker below, then two concise perks and tradeoff. On the RIGHT, a clean 4-by-2 grid of eight large illustrated program cards, all fully visible. Exactly two have a small STARTER corner flag. Preset tabs sit above this grid, school filters just beneath. A compact strip below shows 8/8 DRAFT PROGRAMS and 2/2 STARTERS. SAVE DECK secondary button and ENTER ARENA primary at lower right. No extra duplicated card slots. At the upper left below the title, label this proposal A / LOADOUT WORKBENCH in small restrained cyan type. The grid is the main focus; keep the player body genuinely tiny compared to the grid.
